item.tib: gshen gyi dge spyod rnam par dag pa sngon 'gro yan lag bdun pa
item.coloph: ldong btsun g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas/ dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen gyis bris pa/ 'di bris bdag gis (gi) dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di/ nam mkha'i khyab pa'i sems can thams cad rnams/ myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog/
